implemented: Masked source loads with unspecified inactive-lane values retained
Two configured software fp32 multiplies, exactly 127.0 * (input * inverse_absmax)
Actual existing ComputeExpr.llrint executes a supplied Llrint64 callback
Exact frontend output-register marker reads the preceding llrint result; unknown markers fail
Source-signature-bound int8 narrowing occurs at actual masked stores
Successful whole-stage execution, exact byte readback, and frame at every other region/offset

semantics_extension.integer_store: BitVec.ofInt 8 result64.toInt, stored using its signed toInt representation
semantics_extension.supported_client_fragment: Straight-line source stages with static named region stores. Loops/branches are not extended; pointer-valued integer stores are not covered by these clients.
semantics_extension.existing_library_semantics: Reused for fp32 loads/multiplies, address/mask evaluation, typed memory/register cells, lane write order and frame. No reference result is substituted for execution.

source_correspondence.quantize_global: Complete selected-signature kernel body, with source identifiers renamed to region parameters. Host wrapper remains separate.
source_correspondence.quant_transpose_kernel: Load/quantize/transposed-store tile stage at supplied independent tile coordinates, with pure pointer rematerialization inlined. Original grouped one-dimensional pid mapping and host/grid remain separate.
source_correspondence.formal_checks: SourceChecks pins exact llrint expression tree and precision, store dependency marker, statement counts and int8 source signature.

explicit_numerical_boundaries: Native llrintf, including exceptional inputs and rounding behavior, must instantiate the explicit BitVec64 callback; no native equality is assumed silently.

Native floating multiplication/denormal/compiler correspondence to the chosen FP.Config remains explicit. The TTIR may commute the outer constant operand; this package proves the original source order, not native bitwise equivalence.

The fixed software int8 narrowing is exact modulo-256 signed interpretation. Native store-conversion correspondence is observed in source-bound TTIR and remains a separate native refinement obligation.
remaining_structural_scope: Host abs/max/unsqueeze/reciprocal and relation of loaded inverse_absmax to input
Host allocations/assertions and returned absmax/output tuple
quant_transpose original grouped-pid mapping, including last partial group
Other admitted input/scale dtype routes and exact admission/rejection contracts
existing_proofs: All original proof sources preserved; no existing specification changed or discarded.

public_declarations.statement:
specification quantize_global_fp32_llrint_int8_correctness
    (rest : Algebra Word) (round : Llrint64 Word) (cfg : FP.Config) (s : State Word)
    (X AbsmaxInv Out : RegionName) (N B : Nat) :
    ∃ t, QuantizeIntegerStage.exec (backend rest cfg) (some round) (kernel X AbsmaxInv Out N B) s = some t ∧
      (∀ i, offset s B i < N →
        t.mem Out (offset s B i) = .mk .int (word round cfg s X AbsmaxInv B i).toInt) ∧
      (∀ i, offset s B i < N →
        BitVec.ofInt 8 ((t.mem Out (offset s B i)).read .int) = word round cfg s X AbsmaxInv B i) ∧
      (∀ r o, (r ≠ Out ∨ ∀ i, offset s B i < N → o ≠ offset s B i) → t.mem r o = s.mem r o)

specification quant_transpose_fp32_llrint_int8_correctness (rest : Algebra Word) (round : Llrint64 Word) (cfg : FP.Config) (s : State Word)
    (A AbsmaxInv B : RegionName) (sam san sbn sbm M N BM BN : Nat)
    (hOutInj : Function.Injective (outputOffset s sbn sbm BM BN)) :
    ∃ t, QuantizeIntegerStage.exec (backend rest cfg) (some round) (kernel A AbsmaxInv B sam san sbn sbm M N BM BN) s = some t ∧
      (∀ i, active s M N BM BN i →
        t.mem B (outputOffset s sbn sbm BM BN i) = .mk .int (word round cfg s A AbsmaxInv sam san BM BN i).toInt) ∧
      (∀ i, active s M N BM BN i →
        BitVec.ofInt 8 ((t.mem B (outputOffset s sbn sbm BM BN i)).read .int) =
          word round cfg s A AbsmaxInv sam san BM BN i) ∧
      (∀ r o, (r ≠ B ∨ ∀ i, active s M N BM BN i → o ≠ outputOffset s sbn sbm BM BN i) →
        t.mem r o = s.mem r o)

validation.axioms: Standard base only; no sorry/axiom introduced.
